summary: Retire every current-product authority bridge while retaining bounded historical compatibility readers.
details: Makes src/mod, targets, TargetMaterializer, and the MIR 4.1 development context the only current authorities for their facts.
Classifies 49 former bridges as one retired reassignment and 48 read-only, package-excluded, owned, tested, expiry-bounded historical compatibility paths.
Makes unknown bridge state block deletion and release instead of silently inheriting authority.
Regenerates repository characterization and append-only authority evolution around the final bridge state.
Changes no player package, gameplay, save, setting, migration, compatibility claim, version, tag, signature, seal, or publication gate.
